desc:
⚠️ The game is still in testing. Bugs may occur! ⚠️

Welcome to Criminal Life, an open-world crime game on ROBLOX!

🏙️ Explore a huge city with beaches and a desert
🔫 20+ weapons to collect and use
🚗 20+ vehicles to steal, buy and customize
💰 Rob stores and banks
👮 Escape police, SWAT and helicopter chases
🏁 Street races, missions and gang wars
📈 Level up, upgrade stats and unlock perks
💥 Complete quests, achievements and more!

Your city. Your rules. Your criminal life.

Tags: OpenWorld, Crime, Heist, Police, Cars, Roleplay, Racing, Gangs, Action, GTA6, GTA, Grand Theft Auto 6, Vice City
